relevance.rationale: Constructs the state-integral TQFT from Faddeev's quantum dilogarithm on shaped ideal triangulations with leveled 3-2 Pachner invariance and explicit evaluations on 4_1 and 5_2.

keyResults.statement: Defines a *-functor TQFT on shaped pseudo 3-manifolds invariant under leveled 3-2 Pachner moves via the charged quantum dilogarithm pentagon, with convergent state integrals computed explicitly for 4_1 and 5_2.
keyResults.useForFolio: Primary mathematical construction of quantum-dilogarithm state integrals on 4_1 and 5_2.
